ayahs.1: Tamaam tareefen Allah hi ke laaiq hain jis ne aasmanon ko aur zameen ko paida kiya aur tareekiyon aur noor ko banaya phir bhi kaafir log (ghair Allah ko) apne Rabb ke barabar qaraar dete hain.
ayahs.2: Woh aisa hai jis ne tum ko mitti se banaya phir ek waqt muayyan kiya aur (doosra) muayyan waqt khaas Allah hi ke nazdeek hai phir bhi tum shak rakhte ho.
ayahs.3: Aur wahi hai mabood-e-bar-haq aasmanon mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi, woh tumhare posheeda ahwaal ko bhi aur tumhare zaahir ahwaal ko bhi jaanta hai aur tum jo kuch amal karte ho us ko bhi jaanta hai.
ayahs.4: Aur un ke paas koi nishaani bhi un ke Rabb ki nishaaniyon mein nahi aati magar woh us se eraaz hi karte hain.
ayahs.5: Unhon ne us sachchi kitaab ko bhi jhutlaaya jab ke woh un ke paas pahunchi, so jaldi hi un ko khabar mil jaayegi us cheez ki jis ke saath yeh log istehza kiya karte the.
ayahs.6: Kya unhon ne dekha nahi ke hum un se pehle kitni jamaaton ko halaak kar chuke hain jin ko hum ne dunya mein aisi quwwat di thi ke tum ko woh quwwat nahi di aur hum ne un par khoob baarishen barsaayin aur hum ne un ke neeche se nehren jaari keen. Phir hum ne un ko un ke gunaahon ke sabab halaak kar daala aur un ke baad doosri jamaaton ko paida kar diya.
ayahs.7: Aur agar hum kaaghaz par likha hua koi nawishta aap par naazil farmaate phir us ko yeh log apne haathon se chhoo bhi lete tab bhi yeh kaafir log yahi kehte ke yeh kuch bhi nahi magar sareeh jaadu hai.
ayahs.8: Aur yeh log yun kehte hain ke un ke paas koi farishta kyun nahi utaara gaya aur agar hum koi farishta bhej dete to saara qissa hi khatam ho jaata. Phir un ko zara mohlat na di jaati.
ayahs.9: Aur agar hum us ko farishta tajweez karte to hum us ko aadmi hi banaate aur hamare is feil se phir un par wahi ishkal hota jo ab ishkal kar rahe hain.
ayahs.10: Aur waqai aap se pehle jo paighambar hue hain un ke saath bhi istehza kiya gaya hai. Phir jin logon ne un se mazaaq kiya tha un ko us azaab ne aa ghera jis ka tamaskhur udaate the.
ayahs.11: Aap farma dijiye ke zara zameen mein chalo phiro phir dekh lo ke takzeeb karne walon ka kya anjaam hua.
ayahs.12: Aap kahiye ke jo kuch aasmanon aur zameen mein maujood hai yeh sab kis ki milkiyat hai, aap keh dijiye ke sab Allah hi ki milkiyat hai, Allah ne meharbaani farmaana apne oopar laazim farma liya hai tum ko Allah qayamat ke roz jama karega, us mein koi shak nahi, jin logon ne apne aap ko ghaate mein daala hai so woh imaan nahi laayenge.
ayahs.13: Aur Allah hi ki milkiyat hain woh sab kuch jo raat mein aur din mein rehti hain aur wahi bada sunne wala bada jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.14: Aap kahiye ke kya Allah ke siwa, jo ke aasmanon aur zameen ka paida karne wala hai aur jo ke khaane ko deta hai aur us ko koi khaane ko nahi deta, aur kisi ko mabood qaraar doon, aap farma dijiye ke mujh ko yeh hukm hua hai ke sab se pehle main Islam qubool karoon aur tu mushrikeen mein hargiz na hona.
ayahs.15: Aap keh dijiye ke main agar apne Rabb ka kehna na maanoon to main ek bade din ke azaab se darta hoon.
ayahs.16: Jis shakhs se us roz woh azaab hata diya jaaye to us par Allah ne bada reham kiya aur yeh sareeh kaamyaabi hai.
ayahs.17: Aur agar tujh ko Allah ta'ala koi takleef pahunchaaye to us ka door karne wala siwaaye Allah ta'ala ke aur koi nahi. Aur agar tujh ko Allah ta'ala koi nafa pahunchaaye to woh har cheez par poori qudrat rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.18: Aur wahi Allah apne bandon ke oopar ghaalib hai bartar hai aur wahi badi hikmat wala aur poori khabar rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.19: Aap kahiye ke sab se badi cheez gawaahi dene ke liye kaun hai, aap kahiye ke mere aur tumhare darmiyaan Allah gawaah hai aur mere paas yeh Quran ba-taur-e-wahi ke bheja gaya hai taake main is Quran ke zariye se tum ko aur jis jis ko yeh Quran pahunche un sab ko daraaun kya tum sach much yahi gawaahi doge ke Allah ta'ala ke saath kuch aur mabood bhi hain, aap keh dijiye ke main to gawaahi nahi deta. Aap farma dijiye ke bas woh to ek hi mabood hai aur be-shak main tumhare shirk se bezaar hoon.
ayahs.20: Jin logon ko hum ne kitaab di hai woh log Rasool ko pehchaante hain jis tarah apne beton ko pehchaante hain. Jin logon ne apne aap ko ghaate mein daala hai so woh imaan nahi laayenge.
ayahs.21: Aur us se ziyaada be-insaaf kaun hoga jo Allah ta'ala par jhoot bohtan baandhe ya Allah ki aayaat ko jhoota batlaaye aise be-insaafon ko kaamyaabi na hogi.
ayahs.22: Aur woh waqt bhi yaad karne ke qaabil hai jis roz hum un tamaam khalaiq ko jama karenge, phir hum mushrikeen se kahenge ke tumhare woh shurka, jin ke mabood hone ka tum daawa karte the, kahaan gaye?
ayahs.23: Phir un ke shirk ka anjaam us ke siwa aur kuch bhi na hoga ke woh yun kahenge ke qasam Allah ki apne parwardigaar ki hum mushrik na the.
ayahs.24: Zara dekho to unhon ne kis tarah jhoot bola apni jaanon par aur jin cheezon ko woh jhoot moot taraasha karte the woh sab ghaayib ho gaye.
ayahs.25: Aur un mein baaz aise hain ke aap ki taraf kaan lagaate hain aur hum ne un ke dilon par parda daal rakha hai us se ke woh us ko samjhen aur un ke kaanon mein daat de rakhi hai aur agar woh log tamaam dalaail ko dekh len to bhi un par kabhi imaan na laayen, yahaan tak ke jab yeh log aap ke paas aate hain to aap se khwah makhwah jhagadte hain, yeh log jo kaafir hain yun kehte hain ke yeh to kuch bhi nahi sirf be-sanad baaten hain jo pehlon se chali aa rahi hain.
ayahs.26: Aur yeh log us se doosron ko bhi rokte hain aur khud bhi us se door door rehte hain aur yeh log apne hi ko tabaah kar rahe hain aur kuch khabar nahi rakhte.
ayahs.27: Aur agar aap us waqt dekhen jab ke yeh dozakh ke paas khade kiye jaayen to kahenge haaye kya achchi baat ho ke hum phir waapas bhej diye jaayen aur agar aisa ho jaaye to hum apne Rabb ki aayaat ko jhoota na batlaayen aur hum imaan walon mein se ho jaayen.
ayahs.28: Balke jis cheez ko us ke qabl chhupaaya karte the woh un ke saamne aa gayi hai aur agar yeh log phir waapas bhej diye jaayen tab bhi yeh wahi kaam karenge jis se un ko mana kiya gaya tha aur yaqeenan yeh bilkul jhoote hain.
ayahs.29: Aur yeh kehte hain ke sirf yahi dunyavi zindagi hamari zindagi hai aur hum zinda na kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.30: Aur agar aap us waqt dekhen jab yeh apne Rabb ke saamne khade kiye jaayenge. Allah farmaayega ke kya yeh amr waqai nahi hai? Woh kahenge be-shak qasam apne Rabb ki. Allah ta'ala farmaayega to ab apne kufr ke iwaz azaab chakkho.
ayahs.31: Be-shak khasaare mein pade woh log jinhon ne Allah se milne ki takzeeb ki, yahaan tak ke jab woh muayyan waqt un par dafatan aa pahunchega, kahenge ke haaye afsos hamari kotaahi par jo us ke baare mein hui, aur haalat un ki yeh hogi ke woh apne baar apni peethon par laade honge, khoob sun lo ke buri hogi woh cheez jis ko woh laadenge.
ayahs.32: Aur dunyavi zindagaani to kuch bhi nahi bajuz lahu-o-lab ke. Aur daar-e-aakhirat muttaqiyon ke liye behtar hai. Kya tum sochte samajhte nahi ho.
ayahs.33: Hum khoob jaante hain ke aap ko un ke aqwaal maghmoom karte hain, so yeh log aap ko jhoota nahi kehte lekin yeh zaalim to Allah ki aayaton ka inkaar karte hain.
ayahs.34: Aur bahut se paighambar jo aap se pehle hue hain un ki bhi takzeeb ki ja chuki hai so unhon ne us par sabr hi kiya, un ki takzeeb ki gayi aur un ko eezayen pahunchaayi gayin yahaan tak ke hamari imdad un ko pahunchi aur Allah ki baaton ka koi badalne wala nahi aur aap ke paas baaz paighambaron ki baaz khabren pahunch chuki hain.
ayahs.35: Aur agar aap ko un ka eraaz giraan guzarta hai to agar aap ko yeh qudrat hai ke zameen mein koi surang ya aasman mein koi seedhi dhoond lo phir koi mojiza le aao to karo aur agar Allah ko manzoor hota to un sab ko raah-e-raast par jama kar deta so aap naadaanon mein se na ho jaaiye.
ayahs.36: Wahi log qubool karte hain jo sunte hain. Aur murdon ko Allah zinda kar ke uthaayega phir sab Allah hi ki taraf laaye jaayenge.
ayahs.37: Aur yeh log kehte hain ke un par koi mojiza kyun nahi naazil kiya gaya un ke Rabb ki taraf se aap farma dijiye ke Allah ta'ala ko be-shak poori qudrat hai us par ke woh mojiza naazil farma de. Lekin un mein aksar be-khabar hain.
ayahs.38: Aur jitne qism ke jaandaar zameen par chalne wale hain aur jitne qism ke parind jaanwar hain ke apne dono baazuon se udte hain un mein koi qism aisi nahi jo ke tumhari tarah ke giroh na hon, hum ne daftar mein koi cheez nahi chhodi phir sab apne parwardigaar ke paas jama kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.39: Aur jo log hamari aayaton ki takzeeb karte hain woh to tarah tarah ki zulmaton mein behre goonge ho rahe hain, Allah jis ko chaahe be-raah kar de aur woh jis ko chaahe seedhi raah par laga de.
ayahs.40: Aap kahiye ke apna haal to batlaao ke agar tum par Allah ka koi azaab aa pade ya tum par qayamat hi aa pahunche to kya Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko pukaaroge. Agar tum sachche ho.
ayahs.41: Balke khaas usi ko pukaaroge, phir jis ke liye tum pukaaroge agar woh chaahe to us ko hata bhi de aur jin ko tum shareek thahraate ho un sab ko bhool bhaal jaaoge.
ayahs.42: Aur hum ne aur ummaton ki taraf bhi jo ke aap se pehle guzar chuki hain paighambar bheje the, so hum ne un ko tangdasti aur beemaari se pakda taake woh izhaar-e-ajz kar saken.
ayahs.43: So jab un ko hamari saza pahunchi thi to unhon ne aajizi kyun nahi ikhtiyaar ki? Lekin un ke quloob sakht ho gaye aur shaitaan ne un ke aamaal ko un ke khayaal mein aaraasta kar diya.
ayahs.44: Phir jab woh log un cheezon ko bhoole rahe jin ki un ko naseehat ki jaati thi to hum ne un par har cheez ke darwaaze kushaada kar diye yahaan tak ke jab un cheezon par jo ke un ko mili thin woh khoob itra gaye hum ne un ko daftan pakad liya, phir to woh bilkul mayoos ho gaye.
ayahs.45: Phir zaalim logon ki jad kat gayi aur Allah ta'ala ka shukr hai jo tamaam aalam ka parwardigaar hai.
ayahs.46: Aap kahiye ke yeh batlao agar Allah ta'ala tumhari samat aur basarat bilkul le le aur tumhare dilon par mohar kar de to Allah ta'ala ke siwa aur koi mabood hai ke yeh tum ko phir de de. Aap dekhiye to hum kis tarah dalaail ko mukhtalif pehluon se pesh kar rahe hain phir bhi yeh iraaz karte hain.
ayahs.47: Aap kahiye ke yeh batlao agar tum par Allah ta'ala ka azaab aa pade khwah achanak ya alaaniya to kya bajuz zaalim logon ke aur bhi koi halaak kiya jaayega.
ayahs.48: Aur hum paighambaron ko sirf is waaste bheja karte hain ke woh bashaarat den aur daraayen phir jo imaan le aaye aur durusti kar le so un logon par koi andesha nahi aur na woh maghmoom honge.
ayahs.49: Aur jo log hamari aayaton ko jhoota batlaayen un ko azaab pahunchega ba-wajah is ke ke woh naafarmaani karte hain.
ayahs.50: Aap keh dijiye ke na to main tum se yeh kehta hoon ke mere paas Allah ke khazane hain aur na main ghaib jaanta hoon aur na main tum se yeh kehta hoon ke main farishta hoon. Main to sirf jo kuch mere paas wahi aati hai us ki ittebaa karta hoon. Aap kahiye ke andha aur beena kahin baraabar ho sakta hai. So kya tum ghaur nahi karte?
ayahs.51: Aur aise logon ko daraaiye jo is baat se andesha rakhte hain ke apne Rabb ke paas aisi haalat mein jama kiye jaayenge ke jitne ghair Allah hain na koi un ka madadgaar hoga aur na koi shafee, is umeed par ke woh dar jaayen.
ayahs.52: Aur un logon ko na nikaaliye jo subah-o-shaam apne parwardigaar ki ibaadat karte hain, khaas isi ki razamandi ka qasd rakhte hain. Un ka hisaab zara bhi aap ke mutaalliq nahi aur aap ka hisaab zara bhi un ke mutaalliq nahi ke aap un ko nikaal den. Warna aap zulm karne walon mein se ho jaayenge.
ayahs.53: Aur isi tarah hum ne baaz ko baaz ke zariye se aazmaish mein daal rakha hai taake yeh log kaha karen, kya yeh log hain ke hum sab mein se un par Allah ta'ala ne fazl kiya hai. Kya yeh baat nahi hai ke Allah ta'ala shukr guzaaron ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.54: Aur yeh log jab aap ke paas aayen jo hamari aayaton par imaan rakhte hain to (yun) keh dijiye ke tum par salaamati hai tumhare Rabb ne meharbaani farmaana apne zimma muqarrar kar liya hai ke jo shakhs tum mein se bura kaam kar baithe jahaalat se phir woh us ke baad tauba kar le aur islaah rakhe to Allah (ki yeh shaan hai ke woh) badi maghfirat karne wala hai badi rehmat wala hai.
ayahs.55: Isi tarah hum aayaat ki tafseel karte rehte hain aur taake mujrimon ka tareeqa zaahir ho jaaye.
ayahs.56: Aap keh dijiye ke mujh ko is se mumaanat ki gayi hai ke un ki ibaadat karoon jin ko tum log Allah ta'ala ko chhod kar pukaarte ho. Aap keh dijiye ke main tumhari khwahishaat ki ittebaa na karoonga kyunke is haalat mein to main be-raah ho jaaoonga aur raah-e-raast par chalne walon mein na rahoonga.
ayahs.57: Aap keh dijiye ke mere paas to ek daleel hai mere Rabb ki taraf se aur tum us ki takzeeb karte ho, jis cheez ki tum jaldbazi kar rahe ho woh mere paas nahi. Hukm kisi ka nahi bajuz Allah ta'ala ke, Allah ta'ala waqai baat ko batla deta hai aur sab se achha faisla karne wala wahi hai.
ayahs.58: Aap keh dijiye ke agar mere paas woh cheez hoti jis ka tum taqaaza kar rahe ho to mera aur tumhara baahami qissa-e-faisal ho chuka hota aur zaalimon ko Allah ta'ala khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.59: Aur Allah ta'ala hi ke paas hain ghaib ki kunjiyan, (khazane) un ko koi nahi jaanta bajuz Allah ke. Aur woh tamaam cheezon ko jaanta hai jo kuch khushki mein hain aur jo kuch daryaon mein hain aur koi patta nahi girta magar woh us ko bhi jaanta hai aur koi daana zameen ke tareek hisson mein nahi padta aur na koi tar aur na koi khushk cheez girti hai magar yeh sab kitaab-e-mubeen mein hain.
ayahs.60: Aur woh aisa hai ke raat mein tumhari rooh ko (ek goona) qabz kar deta hai aur jo kuch tum din mein karte ho us ko jaanta hai phir tum ko jaga uthaata hai taake miyaad-e-muayyan tamaam kar di jaaye phir isi ki taraf tum ko jaana hai phir tum ko batlaayega jo kuch tum kiya karte the.
ayahs.61: Aur wahi apne bandon ke oopar ghaalib hai bartar hai aur tum par nigehdaasht rakhne wale bhejta hai yahaan tak ke jab tum mein se kisi ko maut aa pahunchti hai, us ki rooh hamare bheje hue farishte qabz kar lete hain aur woh zara kotahi nahi karte.
ayahs.62: Phir sab apne maalik-e-haqeeqi ke paas laaye jaayenge. Khoob sun lo faisla Allah hi ka hoga aur woh bahut jald hisaab lega.
ayahs.63: Aap kahiye ke woh kaun hai jo tum ko khushki aur darya ki zulmaat se najat deta hai. Tum us ko pukaarte ho gidgida kar chupke chupke, ke agar tu hum ko un se najat de de to hum zaroor shukr karne walon mein se ho jaayenge.
ayahs.64: Aap keh dijiye ke Allah hi tum ko un se najat deta hai aur har gham se, tum phir bhi shirk karne lagte ho.
ayahs.65: Aap kahiye ke is par bhi wahi qaadir hai ke tum par koi azaab tumhare oopar se bhej de ya tumhare paon tale se ya ke tum ko giroh giroh karke sab ko bhida de aur tumhare ek ko doosre ki ladaai chakhha de. Aap dekhiye to sahi hum kis tarah dalaail mukhtalif pehluon se bayaan karte hain shayad woh samajh jaayen.
ayahs.66: Aur aap ki qaum is ki takzeeb karti hai haalaanke woh yaqini hai. Aap keh dijiye ke main tum par tainaat nahi kiya gaya hoon.
ayahs.67: Har khabar (ke wuqoo) ka ek waqt hai aur jald hi tum ko maloom ho jaayega.
ayahs.68: Aur jab aap un logon ko dekhen jo hamari aayaat mein aib-joi kar rahe hain to un logon se kinaara-kash ho jaayen yahaan tak ke woh kisi aur baat mein lag jaayen aur agar aap ko shaitaan bhula de to yaad aane ke baad phir aise zaalim logon ke saath mat baithen.
ayahs.69: Aur jo log parhezgaar hain un par un ki baaz-purs ka koi asar na pahunchega aur lekin un ke zimma naseehat kar dena hai shayad woh taqwa ikhtiyaar karen.
ayahs.70: Aur aise logon se bilkul kinaara-kash rahen jinhon ne apne deen ko khel tamaasha bana rakha hai aur dunyavi zindagi ne unhe dhoke mein daal rakha hai aur is Quran ke zariye se naseehat bhi karte rahen taake koi shakhs apne kirdaar ke sabab (is tarah) na phans jaaye ke koi ghair Allah us ka na madadgaar ho aur na sifaarishi aur yeh kaifiyat ho ke agar dunya bhar ka muawaza bhi de daale tab bhi us se na liya jaaye. Aise hi hain ke apne kirdaar ke sabab phans gaye, un ke liye nihaayat tez garam paani peene ke liye hoga aur dardnaak saza hogi apne kufr ke sabab.
ayahs.71: Aap keh dijiye ke kya hum Allah ta'ala ke siwa aisi cheez ko pukaaren ke na woh hum ko nafa pahunchaye aur na hum ko nuqsaan pahunchaye aur kya hum ulte phir jaayen is ke baad ke hum ko Allah ta'ala ne hidayat kar di hai, jaise koi shakhs ho ke us ko shaitaanon ne kahin jungle mein be-raah kar diya ho aur woh bhatakta phirta ho, us ke kuch saathi bhi hon ke woh us ko theek raasta ki taraf bula rahe hon ke hamare paas aa. Aap keh dijiye ke yaqini baat hai ke raah-e-raast woh khaas Allah hi ki raah hai aur hum ko yeh hukm hua hai ke hum parwardigaar-e-aalam ke poore mutee ho jaayen.
ayahs.72: Aur yeh ke namaz ki paabandi karo aur us se daro aur wahi hai jis ke paas tum sab jama kiye jaaoge.
ayahs.73: Aur wahi hai jis ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko bar-haq paida kiya aur jis waqt Allah ta'ala itna keh dega to ho ja bas woh ho padega. Us ka kehna haq aur ba-asar hai. Aur saari hukumat khaas isi ki hogi jabke soor mein phoonk maari jaayegi, woh jaanne wala hai posheeda cheezon ka aur zaahir cheezon ka aur wahi hai badi hikmat wala poori khabar rakhne wala.
ayahs.74: Aur woh waqt bhi yaad karne ke qaabil hai jab Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ne apne baap Aazar se farmaaya ke kya tu buton ko mabood qaraar deta hai? Be-shak main tujh ko aur teri saari qaum ko sareeh gumraahi mein dekhta hoon.
ayahs.75: Aur hum ne aise hi taur par Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ko aasmaanon aur zameen ki makhlooqaat dikhlaayen aur taake kaamil yaqeen karne walon mein se ho jaayen.
ayahs.76: Phir jab raat ki tareeki un par chha gayi to unhon ne ek sitaara dekha. Aap ne farmaaya ke yeh mera Rabb hai magar jab woh ghuroob ho gaya to aap ne farmaaya ke main ghuroob ho jaane walon se mohabbat nahi rakhta.
ayahs.77: Phir jab chaand ko dekha chamakta hua to farmaaya ke yeh mera Rabb hai lekin jab woh ghuroob ho gaya to aap ne farmaaya ke agar mujh ko mere Rabb ne hidayat na ki to main gumraah logon mein shaamil ho jaaoonga.
ayahs.78: Phir jab aftab ko dekha chamakta hua to farmaaya ke yeh mera Rabb hai yeh to sab se bada hai phir jab woh bhi ghuroob ho gaya to aap ne farmaaya be-shak main tumhare shirk se bezaar hoon.
ayahs.79: Main apna rukh us ki taraf karta hoon jis ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko paida kiya yaksoo ho kar, aur main shirk karne walon mein se nahi hoon.
ayahs.80: Aur un se un ki qaum ne hujjat karna shuroo kiya, aap ne farmaaya kya tum Allah ke maamle mein mujh se hujjat karte ho haalaanke us ne mujh ko tareeqa batla diya hai aur main un cheezon se jin ko tum Allah ke saath shareek banaate ho nahi darta haan agar mera parwardigaar hi koi amar chaahe mera parwardigaar har cheez ko apne ilm mein ghere hue hai, kya tum phir bhi khayaal nahi karte.
ayahs.81: Aur main un cheezon se kaise daroon jin ko tum ne shareek banaaya hai haalaanke tum is baat se nahi darte ke tum ne Allah ke saath aisi cheezon ko shareek thahraaya hai jin par Allah ta'ala ne koi daleel naazil nahi farmaayi, so un do jamaaton mein se aman ka ziyaada mustahiq kaun hai agar tum khabar rakhte ho.
ayahs.82: Jo log imaan rakhte hain aur apne imaan ko shirk ke saath makhloot nahi karte, aison hi ke liye aman hai aur wahi raah-e-raast par chal rahe hain.
ayahs.83: Aur yeh hamari hujjat thi woh hum ne Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ko un ki qaum ke muqaable mein di thi hum jis ko chaahte hain martabon mein badha dete hain. Be-shak aap ka Rabb bada hikmat wala bada ilm wala hai.
ayahs.84: Aur hum ne un ko Ishaaq diya aur Yaqoob, har ek ko hum ne hidayat ki aur pehle zamaana mein hum ne Nooh ko hidayat ki aur un ki aulaad mein se Daaood ko aur Sulaimaan ko aur Ayyub ko aur Yusuf ko aur Moosa ko aur Haaroon ko aur isi tarah hum nek kaam karne walon ko jaza diya karte hain.
ayahs.85: Aur (neez) Zakariya ko aur Yahya ko aur Eesa ko aur Ilyas ko, sab nek logon mein se the.
ayahs.86: Aur neez Ismaeel ko aur Yasa ko aur Yunus ko aur Loot ko aur har ek ko tamaam jahaan walon par hum ne fazeelat di.
ayahs.87: Aur neez un ke kuch baap dadon ko aur kuch aulaad ko aur kuch bhaiyon ko, aur hum ne un ko maqbool banaya aur hum ne un ko raah-e-raast ki hidayat ki.
ayahs.88: Allah ki hidayat hi hai jis ke zariye apne bandon mein se jis ko chaahe us ki hidayat karta hai aur agar farzan yeh hazraat bhi shirk karte to jo kuch yeh aamaal karte the woh sab akarat ho jaate.
ayahs.89: Yeh log aise the ke hum ne un ko kitaab aur hikmat aur nabuwat ata ki thi so agar yeh log nabuwat ka inkaar karen to hum ne is ke liye aise bahut se log muqarrar kar diye hain jo is ke munkir nahi hain.
ayahs.90: Yahi log aise the jin ko Allah ta'ala ne hidayat ki thi, so aap bhi in hi ke tareeq par chaliye. Aap keh dijiye ke main tum se is par koi muawaza nahi chaahta, yeh to sirf tamaam jahaan walon ke waaste ek naseehat hai.
ayahs.91: Aur un logon ne, Allah ki jaisi qadr karna waajib thi waisi qadr na ki jabke yun keh diya ke Allah ne kisi bashar par koi cheez naazil nahi ki. Aap yeh kahiye ke woh kitaab kis ne naazil ki hai jis ko Moosa laaye the jis ki kaifiyat yeh hai ke woh noor hai aur logon ke liye woh hidayat hai jis ko tum ne un mutafarriq auraq mein rakh chhoda hai jin ko zaahir karte ho aur bahut si baaton ko chhupaate ho aur tum ko bahut si aisi baaten bataayi gayi hain jin ko tum na jaante the aur na tumhare bade. Aap keh dijiye ke Allah ne naazil farmaya hai, phir un ko un ke khurafaat mein khelte rehne dijiye.
ayahs.92: Aur yeh bhi aisi hi kitaab hai jis ko hum ne naazil kiya hai jo badi barkat wali hai, apne se pehli kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai aur taake aap Makkah walon ko aur aas paas walon ko daraayen. Aur jo log aakhirat ka yaqeen rakhte hain aise log is par imaan le aate hain aur woh apni namaz par mudawamat rakhte hain.
ayahs.93: Aur is shakhs se ziyaada kaun zaalim hoga jo Allah ta'ala par jhoot tohmat lagaaye ya yun kahe ke mujh par wahi aati hai halaanke us ke paas kisi baat ki bhi wahi nahi aayi aur jo shakhs yun kahe ke jaisa kalaam Allah ne naazil kiya hai isi tarah ka main bhi laata hoon. Aur agar aap is waqt dekhen jabke yeh zaalim log maut ki sakhtiyon mein honge aur farishte apne haath badha rahe honge ke haan apni jaanen nikaalo. Aaj tum ko zillat ki saza di jaayegi is sabab se ke tum Allah ta'ala ke zimme jhooti baaten lagaate the, aur tum Allah ta'ala ki aayaat se takabbur karte the.
ayahs.94: Aur tum hamare paas tanha tanha aa gaye jis tarah hum ne awwal baar tum ko paida kiya tha aur jo kuch hum ne tum ko diya tha us ko apne peechhe hi chhod aaye aur hum to tumhare hamraah tumhare un shafaa'at karne walon ko nahi dekhte jin ki nisbat tum daawa rakhte the ke woh tumhare maamle mein shareek hain. Waaqai tumhare aapas mein to qata-taalluq ho gaya aur woh tumhara daawa sab tum se gaya guzra hua.
ayahs.95: Beshak Allah ta'ala daana ko aur guthliyon ko phaadne wala hai, woh jaandaar ko be-jaan se nikaal laata hai aur woh be-jaan ko jaandaar se nikaalne wala hai. Allah ta'ala yeh hai, so tum kahaan ulte chale ja rahe ho.
ayahs.96: Woh subah ka nikaalne wala hai aur us ne raat ko rahat ki cheez banaaya hai aur sooraj aur chaand ko hisaab se rakha hai. Yeh thahraayi baat hai aisi zaat ki jo ke qaadir hai bade ilm wala hai.
ayahs.97: Aur woh aisa hai jis ne tumhare liye sitaaron ko paida kiya, taake tum un ke zariye se andheron mein, khushki mein aur darya mein bhi raasta maloom kar sako. Beshak hum ne dalail khoob khol khol kar bayaan kar diye hain un logon ke liye jo khabar rakhte hain.
ayahs.98: Aur woh aisa hai jis ne tum ko ek shakhs se paida kiya phir ek jagah ziyaada rehne ki hai aur ek jagah chande, rehne ki. Beshak hum ne dalail khoob khol khol kar bayaan kar diye un logon ke liye jo samajh boojh rakhte hain.
ayahs.99: Aur woh aisa hai jis ne aasmaan se paani barsaaya phir hum ne us ke zariye se har qism ke nabaat ko nikaala phir hum ne us se sabz shaakh nikaali ke us se hum oopar tale daane chadhe hue nikaalte hain aur khajoor ke darakhton se yaani un ke gupphe mein se, khoshe hain jo neeche ko latke jaate hain aur angooron ke baagh aur zaitoon aur anaar ke baaz ek doosre se milte julte hote hain aur kuch ek doosre se milte julte nahi hote. Har ek ke phal ko dekho jab woh phalta hai aur us ke pakne ko dekho, in mein dalail hain un logon ke liye jo imaan rakhte hain.
ayahs.100: Aur logon ne shayateen ko Allah ta'ala ka shareek qaraar de rakha hai halaanke un logon ko Allah hi ne paida kiya hai aur un logon ne Allah ke haq mein bete aur betiyan bila sanad taraash rakhi hain aur woh paak aur bartar hai un baaton se jo yeh karte hain.
ayahs.101: Woh aasmaanon aur zameen ka moojid hai, Allah ta'ala ke aulaad kahaan ho sakti hai halaanke us ke koi biwi to hai nahi aur Allah ta'ala ne har cheez ko paida kiya aur woh har cheez ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.102: Yeh hai Allah ta'ala tumhara Rabb! Us ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laaiq nahi, har cheez ka paida karne wala hai, to tum us ki ibaadat karo aur woh har cheez ka karsaz hai.
ayahs.103: Us ko to kisi ki nigah muheet nahi ho sakti aur woh sab nigaahon ko muheet ho jaata hai aur wahi bada bareek-been bakhabar hai.
ayahs.104: Ab bila-shubha tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ki jaanib se haq-beeni ke zaraai pahunch chuke hain so jo shakhs dekh le ga woh apna faaida karega aur jo shakhs andha rahega woh apna nuqsaan karega, aur main tumhara nigehbaan nahi hoon.
ayahs.105: Aur hum is taur par dalail ko mukhtalif pehluon se bayaan karte hain taake yeh yun kahen ke aap ne kisi se padh liya hai aur taake hum is ko daanishmandon ke liye khoob zaahir kar den.
ayahs.106: Aap khud is tareeq par chalte rahiye jis ki wahi aap ke Rabb ta'ala ki taraf se aap ke paas aayi hai, Allah ta'ala ke siwa koi laaiq-e-ibaadat nahi aur mushrikeen ki taraf khayaal na kijiye.
ayahs.107: Aur agar Allah ta'ala ko manzoor hota to yeh shirk na karte aur hum ne aap ko un ka nigehbaan nahi banaaya. Aur na aap un par mukhtaar hain!
ayahs.108: Aur gaali mat do un ko jin ki yeh log Allah ta'ala ko chhod kar ibaadat karte hain kyunki phir woh barah-e-jahl hadd se guzar kar Allah ta'ala ki shaan mein gustaakhi karenge. Hum ne isi tarah har tareeqa walon ko un ka amal marghoob bana rakha hai. Phir apne Rabb hi ke paas un ko jaana hai so woh un ko batla dega jo kuch bhi woh kiya karte the.
ayahs.109: Aur un logon ne qasmon mein bada zor laga kar Allah ta'ala ki qasam khaayi ke agar un ke paas koi nishaani aa jaaye to woh zaroor hi is par imaan le aayenge. Aap keh dijiye ke nishaaniyan sab Allah ke qabze mein hain aur tum ko is ki kya khabar ke woh nishaaniyan jis waqt aa jaayengi yeh log tab bhi imaan na laayenge.
ayahs.110: Aur hum bhi un ke dilon ko aur un ki nigaahon ko pher denge jaisa ke yeh log is par pehli dafaa imaan nahi laaye aur hum un ko un ki sarkashi mein hairaan rehne denge.
ayahs.111: Aur agar hum un ke paas farishton ko bhej dete aur un se murde baaten karne lagte aur hum tamaam maujoodaat ko un ke paas un ki aankhon ke rubaroo la kar jama kar dete hain tab bhi yeh log hargiz imaan na laate, haan agar Allah hi chaahe to aur baat hai lekin un mein ziyaada log jahaalat ki baaten karte hain.
ayahs.112: Aur isi tarah hum ne har nabi ke dushman bahut se shaitaan paida kiye the kuch aadmi aur kuch jinn, jin mein se baaz baazon ko chikni chupri baaton ka waswasa daalte rehte the taake un ko dhoke mein daal den aur agar Allah ta'ala chaahta to yeh aise kaam na kar sakte so un logon ko aur jo kuch yeh iftira-pardazi kar rahe hain is ko aap rehne dijiye.
ayahs.113: Aur taake is ki taraf un logon ke quloob maayil ho jaayen jo aakhirat par yaqeen nahi rakhte aur taake is ko pasand kar len aur taake murtakib ho jaayen un umoor ke jin ke woh murtakib hote the.
ayahs.114: To kya Allah ke siwa kisi aur faisla karne wale ko talaash karoon halaanke woh aisa hai ke us ne ek kitab-e-kamil tumhare paas bhej di hai, us ke mazameen khoob saaf saaf bayaan kiye gaye hain aur jin logon ko hum ne kitaab di hai woh is baat ko yaqeen ke saath jaante hain ke yeh aap ke Rabb ki taraf se haq ke saath bheji gayi hai, so aap shubha karne walon mein se na hon.
ayahs.115: Aap ke Rabb ka kalaam sachchaai aur insaaf ke aitibaar se kaamil hai, us ke kalaam ka koi badalne wala nahi aur woh khoob sunne wala khoob jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.116: Aur dunya mein ziyaada log aise hain ke agar aap un ka kehna maanne lagen to woh aap ko Allah ki raah se be-raah kar den. Woh mehez be-asl khayaalaat par chalte hain aur bilkul qiyaasi baaten karte hain.
ayahs.117: Bilyaqeen aap ka Rabb un ko khoob jaanta hai jo us ki raah se be-raah ho jaata hai. Aur woh un ko bhi khoob jaanta hai jo us ki raah par chalte hain.
ayahs.118: So jis jaanwar par Allah ta'ala ka naam liya jaaye is mein se khaao! Agar tum us ke ahkaam par imaan rakhte ho.
ayahs.119: Aur aakhir kya wajah hai ke tum aise jaanwar mein se na khaao jis par Allah ka naam liya gaya ho halaanke Allah ta'ala ne un sab jaanwaron ki tafseel bata di hai jin ko tum par haraam kiya hai, magar woh bhi jab tum ko sakht zaroorat pad jaaye to halaal hai aur yeh yaqeeni baat hai ke bahut se aadmi apne khayaalaat par bila kisi sanad ke gumraah karte hain. Is mein koi shubha nahi ke Allah ta'ala hadd se nikal jaane walon ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.120: Aur tum zaahiri gunaah ko bhi chhod do aur baatini gunaah ko bhi chhod do. Bila-shubha jo log gunaah kar rahe hain un ko un ke kiye ki anqareeb saza milegi.
ayahs.121: Aur aise jaanwaron mein se mat khaao jin par Allah ka naam na liya gaya ho aur yeh kaam na-farmaani ka hai aur yaqeenan shayateen apne doston ke dil mein daalte hain taake yeh tum se jidaal karen aur agar tum in logon ki itaa'at karne lago to yaqeenan tum mushrik ho jaaoge.
ayahs.122: Aisa shakhs jo pehle murda tha phir hum ne us ko zinda kar diya aur hum ne us ko ek aisa noor de diya ke woh us ko liye hue aadmiyon mein chalta phirta hai. Kya aisa shakhs us shakhs ki tarah ho sakta hai? Jo tareekiyon se nikal hi nahi paata. Isi tarah kaafiron ko un ke aamaal khush-numa maloom hua karte hain.
ayahs.123: Aur isi tarah hum ne har basti mein wahaan ke raeeson hi ko jaraaim ka murtakib banaaya taake woh log wahaan fareb karen. Aur woh log apne hi saath fareb kar rahe hain aur un ko zara khabar nahi.
ayahs.124: Aur jab un ko koi aayat pahunchti hai to yun kehte hain ke hum hargiz imaan na laayenge jab tak ke hum ko bhi aisi hi cheez na di jaaye jo Allah ke Rasoolon ko di jaati hai, is mauqa ko to Allah hi khoob jaanta hai ke kahaan woh apni paighambari rakhe? Anqareeb un logon ko jinhon ne jurm kiya hai Allah ke paas pahunch kar zillat pahunchegi aur un ki shararaton ke muqaable mein sakht sazaayen.
ayahs.125: So jis shakhs ko Allah ta'ala raasta par daalna chaahe us ke seena ko islam ke liye kushada kar deta hai aur jis ko be-raah rakhna chaahe us ke seena ko bahut tang kar deta hai jaise koi aasmaan mein chadhta hai, isi tarah Allah ta'ala imaan na laane walon par napaaki musallat kar deta hai.
ayahs.126: Aur yahi tere Rabb ka seedha raasta hai. Hum ne naseehat haasil karne walon ke waaste in aayaton ko saaf saaf bayaan kar diya.
ayahs.127: Un logon ke waaste un ke Rabb ke paas salaamati ka ghar hai aur Allah ta'ala un se muhabbat rakhta hai un ke aamaal ki wajah se.
ayahs.128: Aur jis roz Allah ta'ala tamaam khalaiq ko jama karega, (kahega) aye jamaat-e-jinnat ki! Tum ne insaanon mein se bahut se apna liye, jo insaan un ke saath taalluq rakhne wale the woh kahenge ke aye hamare parwardigaar! Hum mein ek ne doosre se faaida haasil kiya tha aur hum apni is muayyan miyaad tak aa pahunche jo tu ne hamare liye muayyan farmaayi, Allah farmaayega ke tum sab ka thikaana dozakh hai jis mein hamesha rahoge, haan agar Allah hi ko manzoor ho to doosri baat hai. Beshak aap ka Rabb badi hikmat wala bada ilm wala hai.
ayahs.129: Aur isi tarah hum baaz kuffaar ko baaz ke qareeb rakhenge un ke aamaal ke sabab.
ayahs.130: Aye jinnat aur insaanon ki jamaat! Kya tumhare paas tum mein se hi paighambar nahi aaye the, jo tum se mere ahkaam bayaan karte aur tum ko is aaj ke din ki khabar dete? Woh sab arz karenge ke hum apne oopar iqraar karte hain aur un ko dunyavi zindagi ne bhool mein daale rakha aur yeh log iqraar karne wale honge ke woh kaafir the.
ayahs.131: Yeh is wajah se hai ke aap ka Rabb kisi basti walon ko kufr ke sabab aisi haalat mein halaak nahi karta ke is basti ke rehne wale be-khabar hon.
ayahs.132: Aur har ek ke liye un ke aamaal ke sabab darje milenge aur aap ka Rabb un ke aamaal se be-khabar nahi hai.
ayahs.133: Aur aap ka Rabb bilkul ghani hai rehmat wala hai. Agar woh chaahe to tum sab ko utha le aur tumhare baad jis ko chaahe tumhari jagah aabaad kar de jaisa ke tum ko ek doosri qaum ki nasal se paida kiya hai.
ayahs.134: Jis cheez ka tum se waada kiya jaata hai woh beshak aane wali cheez hai aur tum aajiz nahi kar sakte.
ayahs.135: Aap yeh farma dijiye ke aye meri qaum! Tum apni haalat par amal karte raho main bhi amal kar raha hoon, so ab jald hi tum ko maloom hua jaata hai ke is aalam ka anjaam-e-kaar kis ke liye naafe hoga. Yeh yaqini baat hai ke haq-talafi karne walon ko kabhi falah na hogi.
ayahs.136: Aur Allah ta'ala ne jo kheti aur mawashi paida kiye hain un logon ne un mein se kuch hissa Allah ka muqarrar kiya aur bazam-e-khud kehte hain ke yeh to Allah ka hai aur yeh hamare maboodon ka hai, phir jo cheez un ke maboodon ki hoti hai woh to Allah ki taraf nahi pahunchti aur jo cheez Allah ki hoti hai woh un ke maboodon ki taraf pahunch jaati hai, kya bura faisla woh karte hain.
ayahs.137: Aur isi tarah bahut se mushrikeen ke khayaal mein un ke maboodon ne un ki aulaad ke qatl karne ko mustahsan bana rakha hai taake woh un ko barbaad karen aur taake un ke deen ko un par mushtaba kar den aur agar Allah ko manzoor hota to yeh aisa kaam na karte, to aap un ko aur jo kuch yeh ghalat baaten bana rahe hain yunhi rehne dijiye.
ayahs.138: Aur woh apne khayaal par yeh bhi kehte hain ke yeh kuch mawashi hain aur khet hain jin ka istemaal har shakhs ko jaaiz nahi, un ko koi nahi kha sakta siwaaye un ke jin ko hum chaahen aur mawashi hain jin par sawaari ya baar-bardaari haraam kar di gayi aur kuch mawashi hain jin par yeh log Allah ta'ala ka naam nahi lete mehaz Allah par iftira baandhne ke taur par. Anqareeb Allah ta'ala unhe un ke iftira ki saza dega.
ayahs.139: Aur woh kehte hain ke jo cheez un mawashi ke pait mein hai woh khaalis hamare mardon ke liye hai aur hamari aurton par haraam hai. Aur agar woh murda hai to is mein sab baraabar hain. Abhi Allah un ko un ki ghalat-bayaani ki saza diye deta hai, bila-shubha woh hikmat wala hai aur woh bada ilm wala hai.
ayahs.140: Waaqai kharaabi mein pad gaye woh log jinhon ne apni aulaad ko mehaz barah-e-hamaqat bila kisi sanad ke qatl kar daala aur jo cheezen un ko Allah ne khaane peene ko di thin un ko haraam kar liya mehaz Allah par iftira baandhne ke taur par. Beshak yeh log gumraahi mein pad gaye aur kabhi raah-e-raast par chalne wale nahi hue.
ayahs.141: Aur wahi hai jis ne baaghaat paida kiye woh bhi jo tattiyon par chadhaaye jaate hain aur woh bhi jo tattiyon par nahi chadhaaye jaate aur khajoor ke darakht aur kheti jin mein khaane ki cheezen mukhtalif taur ki hoti hain aur zaitoon aur anaar jo baaham ek doosre ke mushaabeh bhi hote hain aur ek doosre ke mushaabeh nahi bhi hote, in sab ke phalon mein se khaao jab woh nikal aaye aur is mein jo haq waajib hai woh is ke kaatne ke din diya karo aur hadd se mat guzro, yaqeenan woh hadd se guzarne walon ko na-pasand karta hai.
ayahs.142: Aur mawashi mein oonche qad ke aur chhote qad ke (paida kiye), jo kuch Allah ne tum ko diya hai khaao aur shaitaan ke qadam-ba-qadam mat chalo, bila-shak woh tumhara sareeh dushman hai.
ayahs.143: (Paida kiye) aath nar-o-maada yaani bhed mein do qism aur bakri mein do qism, aap kahiye ke kya Allah ne in dono naron ko haraam kiya hai ya dono maada ko? Ya is ko jis ko dono maada pait mein liye hue hon? Tum mujh ko kisi daleel se to bataao agar sachche ho.
ayahs.144: Aur oont mein do qism aur gaaye mein do qism, aap kahiye ke kya Allah ta'ala ne in dono naron ko haraam kiya hai ya dono maada ko? Ya is ko jis ko dono maada pait mein liye hue hon? Kya tum haazir the jis waqt Allah ta'ala ne tum ko is ka hukm diya? To is se ziyaada kaun zaalim hoga jo Allah ta'ala par bila daleel jhooti tohmat lagaaye, taake logon ko gumraah kare, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala zaalim logon ko raasta nahi dikhlaata.
ayahs.145: Aap keh dijiye ke jo kuch ahkaam ba-zariye wahi mere paas aaye un mein to main koi haraam nahi paata kisi khaane wale ke liye jo is ko khaaye, magar yeh ke woh murdaar ho ya ke behta hua khoon ho ya khinzeer ka gosht ho, kyunke woh bilkul napaak hai ya jo shirk ka zariya ho ke ghair-Allah ke liye naamzad kar diya gaya ho. Phir jo shakhs majboor ho jaaye bashart yeh ke na to taalib-e-lazzat ho aur na tajaawuz karne wala ho to waaqai aap ka Rabb ghafoor-o-raheem hai.
ayahs.146: Aur yahood par hum ne tamaam naakhun wale jaanwar haraam kar diye the aur gaaye aur bakri mein se un dono ki charbiyaan un par hum ne haraam kar di thin magar woh jo un ki pusht par ya antadiyon mein lagi ho ya jo haddi se mili ho. Un ki sharaarat ke sabab hum ne un ko yeh saza di aur hum yaqeenan sachche hain.
ayahs.147: Phir agar yeh aap ko kaazib kahen to aap farma dijiye ke tumhara Rabb badi wasee rehmat wala hai aur us ka azaab mujrim logon se na talega.
ayahs.148: Yeh mushrikeen (yun) kahenge ke agar Allah ta'ala ko manzoor hota to na hum shirk karte aur na hamare baap dada aur na hum kisi cheez ko haraam keh sakte. Isi tarah jo log un se pehle ho chuke hain unhon ne bhi takzeeb ki thi yahaan tak ke unhon ne hamare azaab ka maza chakha. Aap kahiye ke kya tumhare paas koi daleel hai to is ko hamare roobaru zaahir karo. Tum log mehaz khayaali baaton par chalte ho aur tum bilkul atkal se baaten banaate ho.
ayahs.149: Aap kahiye ke bas poori hujjat Allah hi ki rahi. Phir agar woh chaahta to tum sab ko raah-e-raast par le aata.
ayahs.150: Aap kahiye ke apne gawaahon ko laao jo is baat par shahadat den ke Allah ne in cheezon ko haraam kar diya hai, phir agar woh gawaahi de den to aap is ki shahadat na dijiye aur aise logon ke baatil khayaalaat ka ittebaa mat kijiye! Jo hamari aayaton ki takzeeb karte hain aur woh jo aakhirat par imaan nahi rakhte aur woh apne Rabb ke baraabar doosron ko thahraate hain.
ayahs.151: Aap kahiye ke aao main tum ko woh cheezen padh kar sunaaoon jin (yaani jin ki mukhaalifat) ko tumhare Rabb ne tum par haraam farma diya hai, woh yeh ke Allah ke saath kisi cheez ko shareek mat thahraao aur maa baap ke saath ehsaan karo aur apni aulaad ko aflaas ke sabab qatl mat karo. Hum tum ko aur un ko rizq dete hain aur be-hayaai ke jitne tareeqe hain un ke paas bhi mat jaao khwaah alaaniya hon khwaah posheeda, aur jis ka khoon karna Allah ta'ala ne haraam kar diya hai is ko qatl mat karo, haan magar haq ke saath, in ka tum ko taakeedi hukm diya hai taake tum samjho.
ayahs.152: Aur yateem ke maal ke paas na jaao magar aise tareeqe se jo ke mustahsan hai yahaan tak ke woh apne sinn-e-rushd ko pahunch jaaye aur naap tol poori poori karo, insaaf ke saath, hum kisi shakhs ko is ki taaqat se ziyaada takleef nahi dete. Aur jab tum baat karo to insaaf karo, go woh shakhs qaraabatdaar hi ho aur Allah ta'ala se jo ahd kiya is ko poora karo, in ka Allah ta'ala ne tum ko taakeedi hukm diya hai taake tum yaad rakho.
ayahs.153: Aur yeh ke yeh deen mera raasta hai jo mustaqeem hai so is raah par chalo aur doosri raahon par mat chalo ke woh raahen tum ko Allah ki raah se juda kar dengi. Is ka tum ko Allah ta'ala ne taakeedi hukm diya hai taake tum parhezgaari ikhtiyaar karo.
ayahs.154: Phir hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko kitaab di thi jis se achhi tarah amal karne walon par ne'mat poori ho aur sab ahkaam ki tafseel ho jaaye aur rehnumaai ho aur rehmat ho taake woh log apne Rabb ke milne par yaqeen laayen.
ayahs.155: Aur yeh ek kitaab hai jis ko hum ne bheja badi khair-o-barkat wali, so is ka ittebaa karo aur daro taake tum par rehmat ho.
ayahs.156: Kahin tum log yun na kaho ke kitaab to sirf hum se pehle jo do firqe the un par naazil hui thi, aur hum un ke padhne padhaane se mehaz be-khabar the.
ayahs.157: Ya yun na kaho ke agar hum par koi kitaab naazil hoti to hum un se bhi ziyaada raah-e-raast par hote. So ab tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ke paas se ek kitaab waazeh aur rehnumaai ka zariya aur rehmat aa chuki hai. Ab is shakhs se ziyaada zaalim kaun hoga jo hamari in aayaton ko jhoota bataaye aur is se roke. Hum jald hi un logon ko jo ke hamari aayaton se rokte hain un ke is rokne ke sabab sakht saza denge.
ayahs.158: Kya yeh log sirf is amar ke muntazir hain ke un ke paas farishte aayen ya un ke paas aap ka Rabb aaye ya aap ke Rabb ki koi (badi) nishaani aaye? Jis roz aap ke Rabb ki koi badi nishaani aa pahunchegi, kisi aise shakhs ka imaan is ke kaam na aayega jo pehle se imaan nahi rakhta. Ya is ne apne imaan mein koi nek amal na kiya ho. Aap farma dijiye ke tum muntazir raho, hum bhi muntazir hain.
ayahs.159: Beshak jin logon ne apne deen ko juda juda kar diya aur grooh grooh ban gaye, aap ka un se koi taalluq nahi bas un ka maamla Allah ta'ala ke hawaale hai. Phir un ko un ka kiya hua jatla denge.
ayahs.160: Jo shakhs nek kaam karega is ko is ke das guna milenge aur jo shakhs bura kaam karega is ko is ke baraabar hi saza milegi aur un logon par zulm na hoga.
ayahs.161: Aap keh dijiye ke mujh ko mere Rabb ne ek seedha raasta bata diya hai ke woh ek deen mustahkam hai jo tareeqa hai Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ka jo Allah ki taraf yaksoo the. Aur woh shirk karne walon mein se na the.
ayahs.162: Aap farma dijiye ke bilyaqeen meri namaz aur meri saari ibaadat aur mera jeena aur mera marna yeh sab khaalis Allah hi ka hai jo saare jahaan ka maalik hai.
ayahs.163: Is ka koi shareek nahi aur mujh ko isi ka hukm hua hai aur main sab maanne walon mein se pehla hoon.
ayahs.164: Aap farma dijiye ke kya main Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko Rabb banaane ke liye talaash karoon haalaanke woh maalik hai har cheez ka aur jo shakhs bhi koi amal karta hai woh isi par rehta hai aur koi kisi doosre ka bojh na uthaayega. Phir tum sab ko apne Rabb ke paas jaana hoga. Phir woh tum ko jatlaayega jis jis cheez mein tum ikhtilaaf karte the.
ayahs.165: Aur woh aisa hai jis ne tum ko zameen mein khaleefa banaaya aur ek ka doosre par rutba badhaaya taake tum ko aazmaaye un cheezon mein jo tum ko di hain. Bilyaqeen aap ka Rabb jald saza dene wala hai aur bilyaqeen woh waaqai badi maghfirat karne wala meharbaani karne wala hai.
